sheet.title: Leave Tracker
sheet.intro: Keep every person's leave in one place: the yearly leave each person has, every leave taken or asked for, and what is left by type. Low and over-used balances are flagged, and Summary shows who is on leave today and what is waiting for approval. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name and the date your leave year starts. Open Employees and list your people with the leave days each has for the year. You decide the days; the workbook does not add any rules.
Open Leave Log. Add a row for each leave: the first and last day, the person, the type, whether it is Approved, Pending or Rejected, and a reason. The days are counted for you.
Open Balances to see what each person has used and what is left, and Summary for the totals. Start a new workbook, or change the year start in Settings, when a new leave year begins.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam aur leave year kab shuru hota hai wo date likhein. Employees mein logon ki list aur har ek ke saal ke leave din likhein. Din aap tay karte hain.
Leave Log kholein. Har leave ke liye ek row: pehla aur aakhri din, kaun, type, Approved/Pending/Rejected aur karan. Din apne aap ginte hain.
Balances mein dekhein kisne kitna liya aur kitna bacha. Naya leave year shuru ho to Settings mein date badlein.

sheet.balancesSub: Nothing to type here. Used counts Approved leave in the leave year, except Unpaid. Use the filter on Flag to see who is low or over.

sheet.title: Daily Sales Report
sheet.intro: Record every sale and see the day-by-day sales for a month, split by cash, UPI, card and credit. The Daily sheet adds up each day, Items sold shows your best sellers, and Summary gives the month's total, the best day and charts. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name and the first day of the month you want to see. Open Items and list what you sell with the price of each.
Open Sales Log. Add a row for each sale: the date, the item, the quantity and how it was paid. The amount comes from the price in Items. To use a different price for one sale, type it in Rate.
Open Daily to see each day of the month, Items sold for your best sellers and Summary for the totals and charts. Change the month in Settings to look at another month.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam aur us mahine ki pehli tareekh likhein jo dekhna hai. Items mein bechne wala maal aur uski keemat likhein.
Sales Log kholein. Har bikri ke liye ek row: tareekh, item, matra aur payment kaise hui. Rakam Items ki keemat se aati hai. Kisi bikri mein alag keemat ho to Rate mein likhein.
Daily mein har din ki bikri, Items sold mein sabse zyada bikne wala maal aur Summary mein kul bikri aur charts dekhein. Doosra mahina dekhne ke liye Settings mein date badlein.

sheet.dailySub: Nothing to type here. One row for each day of the month in Settings.
sheet.soldSub: Quantity and amount sold for each item in the month, and its share of the month's sales.

sheet.title: Loan and EMI Tracker
sheet.intro: Keep every loan in one place: the EMI, the total interest, the number of EMIs paid, the balance still to pay and the next due date. The Schedule sheet shows every month's interest and principal for any loan, and Summary adds it all up. The EMI is worked out from the amount, the yearly rate and the months you type. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your name. Open Loans and add a row for each loan: the loan name, the amount, the yearly interest rate, the number of months and the date of the first EMI.
The EMI, total interest, EMIs paid, balance and next due date are worked out for you. The status shows Due soon when an EMI is close, and Closed when the last EMI is done.
Open Schedule, pick a loan from the list and see every month: the opening balance, the EMI, how much is interest and how much is principal. Summary shows the totals and a chart.
guideHi: Settings mein apna naam likhein. Loans mein har loan ke liye ek row: naam, rakam, saalana byaaj dar, mahine aur pehli EMI ki tareekh.
EMI, kul byaaj, bhari hui EMI, bacha hua balance aur agli tareekh apne aap nikalte hain. EMI paas ho to Due soon dikhta hai.
Schedule kholein, list se loan chunein aur har mahine ka byaaj aur mool dekhein. Summary mein kul aur chart hai.

sheet.soonDays: Warn this many days before an EMI is due
sheet.settingsHelp: EMIs are counted as paid when their due date is on or before the as of date. Check against your bank statement.
sheet.loansSub: One row for each loan. Type the first six columns. The rest are worked out. The EMI follows the usual equal monthly instalment formula, so your lender's figure may differ a little.
sheet.monthsHelp: The number of monthly EMIs, from 1 to 360.
sheet.firstHelp: The date the first EMI is due. Later EMIs fall on the same day of each month.
